identificationModule.briefTitle: Eltrombopag in Second Line Adult Primary Immune Thrombosytopenia
identificationModule.officialTitle: Eltrombopag as Second Line Therapy in Adult Patients With Primary Immune Thrombocytopenia (ESTIT Study) in an Attempt to Achieve Long-term Remission: a Single Arm Multicenter Phase II Clinical and Biological Study

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A clinical study to evaluate the efficacy of a drug called eltrombopag in adult patients affected of primary immune thrombocytopenia as first treatment to address the disease.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: This is a prospective, multicenter phase II trial designed to evaluate the activity of Eltrombopag second line treatment in adult patients with primary Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP) not responsive or in relapse after a full first line steroids treatment (prednisone or dexamethasone) ± Intravenous Immune Globulin (IVIG).

primaryOutcomes.measure: Number of subjects who achieve long-term response (6 months sustained response) and able to taper down the dose.
primaryOutcomes.description: A patient will achieve this endpoint if at the end of the period of treatment he/she reaches to discontinue Eltrombopag and if, after discontinuation, has absence of bleeding and maintains a platelet count ≥ 30 x 109/L and at least a 2-fold increase from the baseline count in blood cell count performed in the 6 months of the period observation, during which no steroid, Eltrombopag, other anti TPO-R agonists and other anti-ITP medications are administered.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: After one year from study treatment.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of months of response from eltrombopag discontinuation to the last follow-up.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: After one year from study treatment.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of months of complete response from eltrombopag discontinuation to the last follow-up.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: After one year from study treatment.
After one year from study treatment.

otherOutcomes.measure: Modification of immunological parameters during treatment and their relationship with clinical outcomes. (Composite outcome)
Analysis of the relationship between baseline TPO serum level and response to therapy.
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: After six months from treatment start.
